query: For high-entropy-alloy multilayer protective coatings, what testable mechanistic hypothesis could explain their resistance to time-dependent plastic deformation? Specify what governs the behavior and why, an unspecified controlled comparison that would reveal it, the expected observations relative to a baseline, applicable boundaries, supporting evidence, and an outcome that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The enhanced creep resistance of high-entropy-alloy (HEA) multilayer coatings arises from the high density of chemically complex interfaces that simultaneously impede grain‐boundary/pipe diffusion and block dislocation transmission, thereby reducing steady‐state creep rates compared to monolithic HEA coatings of identical average composition.
generation.material_initial_state: Sputter‐deposited HEA multilayer coating comprised of alternating 50 nm equiatomic CoCrFeNi and 50 nm equiatomic MnFeNiV layers, total thickness 10 µm, columnar grain structure
generation.intervention: Compare creep behavior of the HEA multilayer coating to a monolithic HEA coating of the same overall composition and thickness
generation.conditions: Constant uniaxial tensile stress of 300 MPa at 700 °C (≈0.5 Tm) in inert Ar atmosphere for 100 h
generation.structural_mediator: Density and chemical complexity of multilayer interfaces (interface spacing ≈50 nm)
generation.mechanism: (1) Interfaces act as short‐circuit diffusion barriers, reducing effective diffusivity by >10×. (2) Interfaces present modulus and lattice‐parameter mismatches that impede dislocation transmission and accumulation at grain boundaries.
generation.predicted_outcome: HEA multilayer exhibits a steady‐state creep rate at least 5× lower than the monolithic HEA under identical conditions
generation.baseline: Monolithic HEA coating with the same average composition, thickness, and columnar microstructure
generation.boundary: Valid for interface spacings between 10–100 nm, temperatures 0.3–0.6 Tm, and stresses 200–400 MPa; may not apply if layers exceed 200 nm thickness or if T > 0.7 Tm
generation.uncertainty: Moderate—quantitative impact of chemical complexity at these specific interfaces is inferred from analogous multilayer systems but not directly measured for this HEA system

falsification_experiment.design: Prepare three coatings: (A) the HEA multilayer as described, (B) monolithic HEA of identical average composition, (C) multilayer with the same layering but simplified binary alloy compositions. Perform creep tests at 300 MPa and 700 °C for 100 h.
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If coating A does not show a steady‐state creep rate ≥5× lower than coating B, or if coating C matches or outperforms A, the hypothesis is falsified.
